content: I'm a bozo and didn't disable SMS/text 2FA and got booted from leanprover-community on GitHub. I've disabled it now. Would someone please give me access again? My GitHub username is JonBannon. Sorry for the inconvenience!
Can someone give me access again as well? (Have done the exact same thing – Parcly-Taxel)
Oh no, we didn't realise this would actually boot people out! (I thought that just disabling the SMS based 2FA would be enough after the fact.)
Fortunately, nothing is lost, I have records of all the members and their roles before we flipped the 2FA switch. But I can only restore people once they have fixed their 2FA setup.

I think I have now sent out re-invitations for nearly everyone affected: you won't be able to accept these until your 2FA setup is conformant.

However there is a limit to the number of simultaneous outstanding invites we can have, so I'll need to do a second round.

@_Walter Moreira William Coram William Swartworth Yoh Tanimoto Baran Hashemi Sky Wilshaw seem to be the only ones who missed a first round invite (apologies for the alphabetic discrimination there...!)
Even after accepting the invitation, I seem to have lost the ability to edit the distributions project board that had been set up with Anatole and Moritz
The second round has now covered those five.

Luigi Massacci said:
